description: The Houston Health Department's measured daily pollen and mold count (National Allergy Bureau scale) — tree, weed, and grass pollen plus mold spores, with the species actually counted. A real measurement, not a model; counts publish weekday mornings and apply regionally to Crosby, TX.
name: get_pollen

countDate.description: Calendar date (Central time) the count is for; weekends carry Friday's count.

groups.description: tree / weed / grass / mold — each null when that reading was missing from the day's report.

species.description: Per-group list of the types counted above zero, as the lab names them.

updated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last data refresh.

title: Pollen & mold count
